يتحاشوا (form VI)
# يَتَحَاشَوْا (yataḥāšaw) /ja.ta.ħaː.ʃaw/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَحَاشَى (taḥāšā)
# يُتَحَاشَوْا (yutaḥāšaw) /ju.ta.ħaː.ʃaw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَحَاشَى (taḥāšā)
